891-5686-8207.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

824-2728-6797-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-6797-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-6797-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

851-2557-4772-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

301-4419-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1879-3259-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
1879-3259-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2103-3277-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1682-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
1682-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers three times, adding {3}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
1682-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

2034-5003-7093.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peter Parker, adding {C}{C}.
When Peter Parker dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Peter Parker from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Peter Parker enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

147-3505-5231.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1017-2498-6980.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1017-2498-6980.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred and Wizard Class trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Wizard Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
1017-2498-6980.notes: With the additional Wizard Class trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-4089.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Glasspool Mimic
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Glasspool Mimic by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

215-1849-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-1849-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

252-1477-4871.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

864-1312-2034-4871-6633.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2583-3334-5668-5870.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-5475-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
1636-5475-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1300-5855.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
1300-5855.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Virtue of Loyalty triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Virtue of Loyalty's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Virtue of Loyalty's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and untapping them.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1323-2445-4762.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-2445-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

1041-3149.description:
Worms of the Earth prevents any player from playing lands.
Avacyn causes Worms of the Earth to become indestructible, and thus it cannot be destroyed by its ability.
